idea.title: My Cat Just Fired Me
idea.concept: An ordinary office worker discovers that his cat has somehow become the CEO of his company.
idea.hook: My cat fired me this morning.

script.voiceover: My cat fired me this morning. I thought it was a joke—until I walked into the office and saw him in the CEO chair. Mr. Whiskers had called an emergency meeting. He reviewed my performance, knocked my coffee onto the floor, and promoted himself to Chief Executive Officer. Then he presented a slideshow titled, “Why Mike Is Bad at Synergy.” Every employee nodded like this happened daily. I begged for another chance, but he pushed a tiny termination letter across the desk. Fired by my own cat. I packed my things while he scheduled a nap during my old lunch break. Then, before I even reached the elevator, my phone buzzed. Mr. Whiskers had sent me a LinkedIn connection request. Apparently, he still wants to network.
